visualDescriptions.claimLimit: Visible appearance only; subject identity, selector, game use and playback semantics remain unproven.

provenanceLimit: Archive bytes are from fixture/candidate copies; the original WHDLoad install-path copy was unavailable.

decoderFindings.rle: Strict bounded full-stream Amiga RLE; truncated literal/repeat runs are rejected.
decoderFindings.frameLayout: 88x88 5-plane frames; bitmap start is derived from decoded stream length minus frameCount*(5280+1). Header span must cover the frame-count metadata.
decoderFindings.xor: PIC frame 0 is stored directly; every later frame is XOR-reconstructed against frame 0.
decoderFindings.rendererAgreement: Each decoded frame matches the corrected offline renderer manifest and every pixel of its 4x source render; this is not an independent historical pixel golden.
decoderFindings.semantics: Frame order is established; timing, animation meaning, selectors and runtime admission remain unknown.
